message.content:
The most visited market in New York City is **Chelsea Market**.  
It’s a bustling food hall and retail space in the Meatpacking District that attracts hundreds of thousands of visitors each year—often more than any other indoor market in the city. Its mix of gourmet food vendors, specialty shops, and a lively atmosphere makes it a top destination for both locals and tourists.
